sections.Profile:
Cherry Bell is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Sonic in February 1978. The game features a gambling theme, with artwork depicting can-can dancers and a man playing slot machines. Its playfield includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, six standup targets, and four kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Segasa
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Women, Gambling, Nightlife, Original Theme, 1970s
